# NK Digital Tech

> NK Digital Tech is a specialised digital marketing and search engine optimisation company engineering organic search authority, AI search visibility, local map pack dominance, and high performance web architecture for commercial enterprises across Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, and Lucknow.

NK Digital Tech bridges traditional technical SEO with conversational Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO). The agency structures corporate entity profiles, schema markup, and commercial content so enterprises are accurately cited across Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. All campaigns are managed directly by senior specialists with full client code and analytics ownership.

- [Company Profile](https://www.nkdigitaltech.net/#about): Senior led digital marketing and search consultancy delivering verified commercial inquiries, phone calls, and pipeline growth.

- [Client Case Studies and Feedback](https://www.nkdigitaltech.net/#testimonials): Documented inbound inquiry growth across healthcare clinics, real estate firms, legal advisory chambers, coaching academies, and industrial manufacturers.
